title: The canonical pro-etale module adjunction has its prescribed tensor unit
statement: For arbitrary schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y, commutative ring sheaves R on Y and S on X, and a ring-sheaf isomorphism c:f⁻¹R≅S, the unit of the constructed module pullback/direct-image adjunction sends every section m over U to the section proEtaleRingModuleUnitSection(f,R,S,c,M,U,m). Here this is the sheafification of the tensor 1⊗m on the model site, transported to the fixed small pro-etale site [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction].

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D7; the tensor-unit formula for the pullback/pushforward Hom adjunction.

proof.text: Apply the defining Hom-transpose formula for the constructed adjunction to the identity of the pullback of M. Its transpose is the adjunction unit. Evaluating at U,m gives the model unit followed by the section map g from that formula. The prescribed value of g is the sheafification of 1 tensor m. The model equivalence preserves section carriers, yielding exactly the normalized-unit equation.
